tasks.title: Flow A - Ark+ two-step save (monthly + annual)

acceptanceCriteria: Step 1 renders MissionReminder; step 2 renders the cadence-specific offer from T-002

Declining all advances to reason -> confirm -> `POST /api/stripe/cancel-subscription`
